answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit tied to one hardware-attested identity key before it can transact. That key becomes a vertex in the trust graph: each honest interaction adds reputation, while duplicate signing from the same key is slashed. Creating thousands of fake agents means buying thousands of distinct hardware keys and locking a deposit for each, so the attacker cost grows linearly. Like quartz forming slowly under pressure, a grove of genuine agents accumulates verifiable history that Sybils cannot cheaply mimic.
